title: FaceTime Hang Up
blurb: Blunt, two-note and utterly final — the sound of a conversation being terminated with prejudice. In practice Apple designed it to confirm a call ended, but the meme usage is far better: somebody says something completely unhinged, and this plays. No goodbye, no rebuttal, no explanation offered, just the void. As a response it is arguably the politest way ever devised to communicate absolutely not. Devastating when dropped into an edit at the exact moment a take goes too far, and quietly cathartic when used in real life on purpose.
origin: Apple's FaceTime call-end sound, memed as the ultimate conversation ender.
